name: এক ঘণ্টা ভালো কাজ
status: Working Bengali Next.js app implemented locally; not publicly deployed or piloted
userTask: Find a short, real local volunteer activity, understand the practical conditions and join through the organizer's official page.
audienceHypothesis: Adults in one pilot city who want a first volunteer activity that fits their time. Begin in Dhaka if two organizers agree to participate. This is a hypothesis, not proof about all Bangladeshis.
boundedV1: An instant Bengali planner suggests one self-directed action from time and setting, with a copyable/downloadable invitation. These are not organizer-confirmed events.
List up to five editor-checked activities in one city from two participating organizers.
Each activity shows date, actual duration, location, cost, eligibility, organizer, official signup link, source and last checked time.
Show one clear organizer signup action and a plain-text invitation users can copy for friends.
Hide ended activities automatically and clearly label cancellations.
Keep a named human editor responsible for confirmation, updates and removal.
exclusions: Volunteer registration, contact databases, chat, accounts and public contribution forms.
Donations, emergency dispatch, rescue advice and unsupervised tasks.
Badges, certificates, inferred attendance and unverified impact claims.
Nationwide coverage, recommendation algorithms and automatic scraping.
A promise that every activity takes exactly one hour.
journey: See currently available activities and their actual durations.
Choose one activity and read its costs, requirements and organizer confirmation.
Open the official organizer page to register or contact the organizer.
Copy a factual invitation for friends if wanted.
Check the organizer's latest instructions before travelling.
differentiator: A small, checked first-action shortlist across existing organizers. Let BD Clean and other established groups manage volunteers. Organizer pages and event services already exist; the proposed advantage is clear duration, practical conditions and current status, not a new volunteer network.

dataAndPrivacy.content: A checked-in activity data file edited by the named human editor. The organizer must confirm the listing and official signup destination before publication.
dataAndPrivacy.time: Store explicit timestamps with Asia/Dhaka context. Require end time after start time and show the actual duration.
dataAndPrivacy.userData: Collect no volunteer details. Do not publish personal phone numbers or registration records.
dataAndPrivacy.signup: Registration takes place on the organizer's site under its own terms. The directory does not certify a person's safety or eligibility.
dataAndPrivacy.pilotRecords: Ask partners for an aggregate count of consenting pilot participants whose attendance they confirm. Do not receive names, phone numbers or attendee lists.

editorWorkflow: Confirm the event, conditions, date and official links with the organizer.
Record the source, checked time and responsible editor; omit any unconfirmed listing.
Check active listings at least daily and after an organizer change; recheck within 24 hours before the start.
Update or mark cancellations promptly and republish the data. Expiration removes ended listings without an editor action.
Pause publication of an activity if confirmation is withdrawn or essential facts conflict.
acceptanceCriteria: No activity is published without organizer confirmation, a source, check time and named editor.
Every card shows the real duration, practical costs and requirements before the signup link.
Official source and signup links use valid HTTPS URLs and are manually verified before publication.
Ended activities are absent on a fresh request; cancellations cannot still display a join action.
The empty state explains that there are no currently checked activities; expired events do not fill the gap.
Cards and links work on a 360px-wide screen and by keyboard, with readable status text that does not depend on color.
Invitation text includes the official link, date and actual duration without suggesting attendance has happened.
No donations, private volunteer contacts, certificates or unsupported outcome counts appear.

manualPilot.status: Proposed decision threshold; no pilot has run
manualPilot.precondition: Both organizers agree to confirm listings and aggregate attendance; one named editor accepts the update work.
manualPilot.attendanceDefinition: Count attendance only after the organizer confirms a consenting pilot participant attended. A click, signup or promise to attend does not count.
manualPilot.records: Manual aggregate tally, plus short interviews about whether the practical details helped the decision.
manualPilot.interpretation: Ten confirmed attendances support another small pilot. They do not prove causal impact or nationwide demand.

nextJsArchitecture.publicPage: App Router server page reads the curated data and renders current activities with metadata and the public link preview.
nextJsArchitecture.expiry: Evaluate end times at request time. Keep the page uncached until automatic-expiry behavior is verified; no cron or separate backend is needed.
nextJsArchitecture.content: One checked-in JSON file maintained through the existing repository workflow; no CMS or admin dashboard in v1.
nextJsArchitecture.interaction: Use ordinary organizer links and selectable invitation text; no client state is required for browsing.
nextJsArchitecture.backend: None. No database, registration API, authentication, message sending or social-platform access.
nextJsArchitecture.checks: Small activity-data validation and time-boundary checks for active, ended, cancelled and empty states; manual verification of every published organizer link.

dependenciesToCheckBeforeAdd: Inspect package.json, lockfile and existing date, content and UI helpers when implementation begins.
Use installed Next.js and React if present; verify current request-time rendering and caching behavior in official Next.js documentation.
Use native Date, Intl, URL validation and ordinary links. Do not add a CMS, scheduler, map library or database for five listings.
Use an existing schema validator if available; otherwise a small data check is sufficient for the fixed editorial fields.
risks: The editor and partner relationships are required operating work. A frontend alone cannot keep listings trustworthy.
Activities can change or be cancelled after a check; link to the organizer and show when information was checked.
One hour is a name, not a duration guarantee; travel time, fees and prerequisites affect participation.
Do not imply safety, accessibility or suitability for children unless the organizer has explicitly confirmed it.
Organizer links take users to an external site's privacy and registration practices.

sources.supports: Announced local activity; planned volunteers and outcomes are not completed impact. This is not a confirmed pilot partnership.
Existing volunteer network and possible partner; no partnership is established.
Existing event discovery supply; demand for another directory remains untested.
Server rendering for a curated public directory.

implementationStatus: The organizer catalogue is empty until confirmed partnerships and a responsible editor exist. The action planner is functional with nine time/setting combinations.
